_comment: VP-1 'The Emperor's Designs' (docs/VP1_DESIGNS_SPEC.md §2, §8) — the authored block europe_1805.json ships under the key `imperial_designs` (S14b part 2); this fixture is pinned equal to it, comment keys aside.

designs.title: The Confederation of the Rhine
designs.hint: Three of Bavaria, Hesse, Saxony and Hanover under the Emperor's protection — each France's satellite at loyalty 40 or more, held four end turns.
designs.control: F1 → the court → Propose Vassal (at peace) or Subjugate (at war); Invest in Vassal keeps a member's loyalty

designs.title: A German Crown Brought to Terms
designs.hint: Austria or Prussia brought to terms: two of her own provinces or her capital ceded to the Empire (a partition), her vassalage (subjugation), or a compensated peace and her alliance within twenty turns (the moderate peace).
designs.control: F1 → Austria or Prussia → Open Settlement (the war's terms), or Propose Peace

gate.reason: the Kingdom of Italy must be France's

designs.title: The Throne of Naples
designs.hint: Naples titled to the Empire — her court France's satellite at loyalty 40 or more, or Naples held twelve quiet turns.
designs.control: F1 → Naples → Send Ultimatum (a casus belli at half the price), then Propose Vassal

designs.title: The Iron Crown
designs.hint: Milan, Piedmont and Carniola titled to the Empire, and Austria brought to terms.
designs.control: F1 → Austria → Open Settlement — Carniola ceded to the Kingdom of Italy

roads.title: The Continental System
roads.proclamation: The Blockade of the British Isles

gate.reason: France must be at war with the mistress of the seas

designs.title: The Blockade of the British Isles
designs.hint: 13 of the Continent's 26 ports shut to Britain, held six end turns — a court at war with her, in the System by a peace's clause, France's satellite, or with her capital held by a power at war with her.
designs.control: F1 → the court → a peace's Joins the Continental System clause; the Strategic Ledger's Admiralty counts the ports

designs.title: The Peace of the Continent
designs.hint: After the Blockade, Britain signs a war-ending peace with France — a great power in the System by France's clause, no lifting clause, France's own provinces whole.
designs.control: F1 → Britain → Propose Peace (no lifting clause)

acts.title: The Temple of Glory
acts.says: The Madeleine rebuilt as a temple to the Grand Army — the names of the fallen on its walls, the Empire's glory made stone.

acts.title: The Princes' Dotations
acts.says: Domains and pensions for the German princes who sit in the Confederation — their crowns guaranteed, their loyalty bought.

acts.title: The Abolition of Feudalism
acts.says: The baronies of the Kingdom of Naples abolished by decree — the Code in the south, the barons' courts closed.

acts.title: The Raft on the Niemen
acts.says: Two emperors on a raft midstream — the beaten court courted, not crushed, and asked to shut its ports against Britain.
